title: Orbit release runway and embargo playbook for API/Console/Runtime
creator: Riley Chen
description:
Purpose: Create an operational playbook that sequences milestones, scope arbitration, and embargo/comms windows for the April 2026 release train covering API, Console, and Runtime. This ticket captures the milestone runway, objective cut criteria (SLO, test, docs, rollout), the release-notes coordination checklist, and the cross-team GTM tasks (support readiness, partner comms, marketplace updates). Goal is to reduce last-minute scope churn and ensure consistent messaging across channels.

Scope:
- Define target milestones & signoff gates for each component (API / Console / Runtime).
- Establish quantifiable cut criteria per component (latency & throughput SLOs for Runtime, API contract stability, Console UX QA pass).
- Draft embargo sequencing & comm windows for internal stakeholders, early access customers, and public launch.
- Release notes and changelog templates, owners, and approval flow.
- Cross-team task list: security review, support KB, migration notes, partner marketplace updates, billing and quotas checks.

Non-goals: In-depth rollout automation (covered in ENG tickets), refactoring runtime kernels (tracked separately), and deep legal review (handled by Legal with separate intake).

Milestones (proposed):
- M1 Kickoff & alignment: 2026-03-03 (owner: PM)
- M2 Feature freeze for must-haves: 2026-03-24 (owner: ENG leads)
- M3 Docs & release notes draft ready: 2026-03-31 (owner: DX writer)
- M4 Preflight telemetry & canary plan ready: 2026-04-07 (owner: Reliability)
milestone_breakdown: M1 Kickoff & alignment - 2026-03-03 - agenda: owners, deps, early risk register
M2 Must-have scope freeze - 2026-03-24 - engineering features gated by test/benchmark results
M3 Docs & RN draft - 2026-03-31 - release-notes owner publishes initial draft in Drive
M4 Preflight & canary - 2026-04-07 - SLO verification, rollback playbook validated
M5 Embargo lift & public launch - 2026-04-15 - comms plan executed
cut_criteria: Runtime: 95th p99 latency within 110% of baseline and no degradation >3% for production workloads
API: Contract stability confirmed (no breaking changes to published endpoints), API schema tests >= 98% pass
Console: Core task flows validated (login, model selection, rollout config) with UX regression <5 issues
E2E tests: Critical path smoke tests green across regions
Docs & RN: Release notes approved and localization placeholders created
Security & Compliance: Security review signed-off and KMS integration documented
embargo_and_comms: Internal embargo window: 2026-04-07 to 2026-04-14 - limited internal preview only
Early access cohort: staggered invites 2026-04-08 to 2026-04-12 - telemetry focused
Public launch embargo lift: 2026-04-15 09:00 PT - coordinated press/social scheduling
Comms owners: PM (announce), Marketing (external), Growth (docs/snippets), Support (KB)
PR/Marketplace cadence: ensure vendor marketplace listing updated 24h before public launch
release_notes_checklist: Owner assigned and draft in Drive (link below)
One-line summary + why it matters for each change
Migration / integration notes for API changes
Security & compliance bullet for private deployments
Localization plan for major markets (NA, EU, APAC)
Changelog entries for repo tags and SDK versions

risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Late perf regression in runtime discovered during canary - Mitigation: predefined rollback to previous model variant and enable degraded-tier routing
Risk: API contract change requires client updates - Mitigation: keep previous endpoint available with deprecation header for 6 weeks
Risk: Console regression affecting onboarding - Mitigation: gated rollout to 10% of orgs with realtime UX telemetry
Risk: Release notes not localized in time - Mitigation: publish English RN with clear localization placeholders and schedule staggered localized pushes
